title: reusable-footnotes — book global numbering
text:
1 Chapter 1 — global footnote numbering
This HTML book keeps reusable-footnote identity local to each chapter page while continuing the displayed footnote numbers across chapters.
José Afonso da Silva is cited first.1
The same citation appears again in this chapter and reuses footnote 1.1
The Constitution receives footnote 2.2
The next chapter therefore begins at 3, even though its reusable-footnote scope is independent.

title: 2  Doctrine
text:
3 Chapter 2 — numbering continues
This chapter is a new HTML page, so José Afonso da Silva receives a new page-local footnote. Because numbering is global, that footnote is 3.1
A repeated occurrence in this chapter reuses footnote 3.1
A historical source receives footnote 4.2
Repeating it in the same chapter reuses footnote 4.2
The third chapter therefore begins at 5.

title: 3  Constitution
text:
4 Chapter 3 — global sequence, local reuse
The Constitution appears again in this chapter as a new page-local footnote numbered 5.1
A repeated occurrence reuses footnote 5.1
José Afonso da Silva then receives footnote 6 in this chapter.2
This demonstrates the book-wide numbering variant: each chapter page owns its footnotes, while the visible numbering continues across the book.
